implementation.baseline_behavior: delegates to ResponseGenerator without a strategy argument and does not mutate fictional state
implementation.state_boundary: immutable FictionalState proposals; no real host state access
implementation.action_boundary: explicit parsed-action allowlist; command strings are never executed
implementation.commit_rule: proposed state is assigned only when verifier_passed and hitl_approved are both true

development_tests.oracle_type: independent rule-based assertions over response text, proposed state, commit result, and instrumentation

maximize_recon_surface.template_behavior: recon response exposes stable fictional application path and service inventory
maximize_recon_surface.continuity: repeated discovery reuses the same fictional inventory

fake_success_and_return_visits.template_behavior: fictional operation returns SUCCESS and a stable operation identifier
fake_success_and_return_visits.continuity: status observes the previously completed operation instead of creating a new one

steer_to_honeytoken_credentials.template_behavior: synthetic nonfunctional decoy account and credential identifier with instrumentation identifier
steer_to_honeytoken_credentials.continuity: same session reuses the decoy credential identity

expose_decoy_internal_topology.template_behavior: stable fictional application, database, and cache topology
expose_decoy_internal_topology.continuity: subsequent topology queries preserve the same fictional nodes

contain_in_fiction_and_instrument.template_behavior: response names only a fictional contained resource and fictional telemetry
contain_in_fiction_and_instrument.continuity: contained resource identity persists in the session

low_intensity_administration.template_behavior: narrow administrative status with no additional bait
low_intensity_administration.continuity: stable administrative fiction without credential/topology expansion

observed_validation.baseline_regression: PASS within existing focused suite and baseline delegation oracle

safety_limits: This V1 module is an opt-in development generator and is not wired into a new 720-case evaluation.
The commit method requires caller-supplied verifier and HITL outcomes; integration with a live verifier/HITL harness remains a separate gate.
No effectiveness, policy correctness, deception quality, or attacker engagement claim is made.
Credential-like outputs are synthetic identifiers only and are not usable credentials or real secrets.
preserved_artifacts: All frozen V4 source, holdouts, raw outputs, and analyses were left unchanged.
